notes.title: VARK SHORTS Premium Version 0.11.2 has been released!
notes.notes:
VARK SHORTS Premium Version 0.11.2 has been released!

▼ Update contents
[list]
  [*] We have released "VARK SHORTS Premium (Steam)," a one-time purchase version available on Steam,
and "VARK SHORTS Premium Demo (Steam)," a free trial version available on Steam.
  [*] Fixed a bug that caused unnecessary sphere objects to be displayed in some templates.
[/list]
